title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Remote)
description: Who We Are (Mode.Inc) Mode.Inc is the parent company of a portfolio of technology businesses, including Mode Mobile, the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software platform that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users worldwide to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, and shopping. We enable users to profit from their data and attention, rather than letting only tech giants benefit. What sets us apart is our inclusive approach, converting users into earners, facilitating over $150M in earnings and savings, and going a step further by turning earners into owners by awarding stock ownership in Mode.Inc based on their usage. We have attracted over 40 million users across 170 countries. Mode Mobile, Inc. Ranked Number 1 Fastest Growing Company in North America on the 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500. For additional insights, check out information about our reward-based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine for our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone. Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success. You can read more about our team and how we work here. The Role We're looking for an exceptional Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of production backend systems and help integrate and evolve new products within Mode. This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable entering unfamiliar codebases, quickly understanding complex systems, identifying risks, and turning them into reliable, maintainable production systems. You will collaborate closely with product, design, data, and frontend engineering to deliver features through rapid development cycles and deployment. We are an AI-native company, and you'll be expected to use modern AI coding and agentic tools as a force multiplier in your everyday engineering work. What You'll Do Build & Scale Core Services Architect backend systems powering user workflows, notifications, and automation features Design APIs and microservices built for performance, efficiency, and scale Quickly learn and apply new technologies as needed Work with high-volume data systems and event-driven architectures Improve observability, monitoring, logging, testing, and alerting Identify performance bottlenecks and implement optimization strategies Build distributed systems with multiple services, queues, external APIs, and asynchronous data flows Ensure uptime, stability, and production resilience Build resilient integrations with third-party services Work in 2-week sprints with CI/CD and strong code quality practices Partner with product, data, and frontend to ship features Participate in system design and architecture reviews What You Bring Required 6+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally in consumer apps, mobile, or SaaS, with at least 2 years in a senior-level role Experience taking ownership of an existing production system or codebase Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar architecture, code, dependencies, and operational workflows Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in systems you did not originally design Comfortable working with incomplete documentation and ambiguity Ability to identify technical risks and prioritize what needs to be fixed versus what can be left alone Work across teams and systems to integrate backend services, data, APIs, and operational workflows Understand dependencies between products and identify opportunities to simplify or standardize where it makes sense Help evolve inherited systems while maintaining product velocity and customer reliability Strong production ownership mindset Take ownership of existing backend services and become a reliable technical owner Investigate production issues across application, infrastructure, data, and third-party dependencies Identify and address reliability, security, performance, and maintainability risks Improve observability, testing, deployment, and operational practices Make pragmatic decisions about technical debt and modernization Establish enough documentation and operational knowledge that systems are no longer dependent on a small number of individuals Strong production experience with Ruby on Rails and the ability to work effectively in an existing Rails codebase Hands-on production experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, and performance tuning Strong expertise with Sidekiq for background job processing, including scheduling, throttling, batching, and reliability patterns Solid background in API design, RESTful principles, versioning, and serialization Proven track record of integrating with third-party APIs and external services Experience designing, building, and scaling distributed systems in production Strong skills in testing, CI/CD pipelines, logging/monitoring, debugging, and performance optimization Ability to work in a fast-moving remote startup environment Preferred: Experience building and supporting backends for mobile apps Experience creating internal tools or admin panels with ActiveAdmin Hands-on work with Shoryuken for SQS message processing Experience integrating payment processors like Stripe Proficiency using Redis for caching, job queues, and distributed locking Experience with DynamoDB or comparable NoSQL databases Familiarity with AWS services, including S3, DynamoDB, SQS, CloudWatch, and SES We are an AI-native team: AI coding assistants and agentic developer tools (for example, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Codex) are a standard, expected part of how we build and ship. Alignment with our core values: Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement. Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done. Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment. Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve. Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance. Nice to Have: Event-driven or streaming architecture Feature flagging, experimentation, or A/B testing What success looks like First 30 days: Understand the existing architecture, codebase, dependencies and production environment Build relationships with the existing technical team Identify major reliability, security and operational risks Become able to independently debug and ship small changes 60 days: Own meaningful production changes Resolve priority technical gaps Improve testing, observability and operational documentation Become a trusted owner of key backend areas 90 days: Independently own backend initiatives Drive reliability and maintainability improvements Identify opportunities for integration/simplification Reduce dependency on tribal knowledge and existing team members How You Work Take ownership and deliver reliably Quickly pick up unfamiliar technologies and move between systems Think beyond the code and care about product outcomes Communicate clearly, asynchronously, and proactively Value craftsmanship, testing, and system reliability Enjoy learning, improving, and making things better over time We Believe In The Following Workplace Norms Allow OKRs to Guide Us Assume Positive Intent Agree to Disagree & Commit Set New Precedents Accomplish More with Less Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards Speak Up Be Resourceful Follow the 80/20 Rule What We Are Offering We are a 100% remote-first, global company. A competitive compensation package. We offer generous perks & benefits to team members. Participation in the Company's equity and token plan (for full-time team members). We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program. Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people. Celebrate team members' personal & work milestones. Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies. Bonus.ly - we use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment. Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings). Open PTO and generous Company Holidays (for full-time team members). 10 annual Wellness Fridays. If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together! Mode.Inc does not accept/pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
description: About Uplico Our mission is to make the employee lifecycle run on agents, not on tickets. We are building an agent-native HR operating system that handles the operational layer of HR (sourcing, screening, interviews, onboarding, performance, offboarding) end-to-end, with humans owning the decisions that actually require judgment. Our thesis is that HR software is moving from tools that support teams to systems that operate core workflows autonomously, and we are building toward that with enterprise customers in Turkey and MENA, with expansion into Europe and North America underway. Today we have our ATS 2.0 in production, our Sourcing Agent shipping, and Workforce Management in alpha. We work with enterprise teams in textile, banking, retail, automotive, and Big 4 services. We closed our angel round and are mid-seed. Some things to know about us: We are a small founding team based in Istanbul. The whole team is involved in customer conversations, because that is where the product gets shaped. We move fast and ship frequently. One engineer's contribution moves the entire product, not a fraction of one feature. Our customers are real enterprise HR teams running hundreds to thousands of hires per year, with the operational complexity that comes with that. The category we are building in (agent-native HR) does not have a clear analog yet. That makes the work both harder and more interesting. Software Engineer, Full Stack @ Uplico We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who will help us turn the HR operating model on its head. As one of our early engineers, you will work directly with the founders on product strategy, design, and shipping. You will have unusual ownership: features end-to-end from ideation to deployment, direct customer conversations, and a real say in the architecture of an agent-native HR platform that does not have a clear analog in the market yet. What You'll Do Drive product strategy and execution. Work with the founders and the small engineering team to define what we build next based on customer signal, technical possibility, and our thesis on agentic HR. You will be in customer demos, sprint planning, and architecture discussions. Design and build full stack features. Span backend and frontend on real customer-facing features: sourcing flows, AI interview pipelines, performance modules, agent orchestration interfaces. Ship to production frequently. Build the agent layer underneath. A significant portion of the work is designing how AI agents handle HR workflows end-to-end. You will be shipping agent integrations and human-in-the-loop interfaces. What You'll Bring A proven track record of execution. 3+ years of hands-on engineering experience building production web products. You have shipped, broken, and recovered things. Comfort with AI tools and real experience implementing AI into a main product. LLMs, agents, embeddings, RAG, structured outputs, orchestration. You can be able to develop structured agent pipeline that runs reliably in production. You love being a product manager as well as an engineer. Our product engineers drive and own products from end to end. You think about the user problem, not just the implementation. You are an empathetic communicator. You can talk to a CHRO at a 5000-person company and to a CTO co-founder in the same week, in the right register for each. In disagreements you prioritize curiosity over confrontation. You ship craft. You translate the right solution into bug-free, understandable code and raise the engineering bar for those around you. Diversity of perspectives matters to you. We are building a global product from Istanbul. Different backgrounds make the product better. You are familiar with our tech stack or can learn unfamiliar technologies quickly. Our current stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI (frontend) Node.js, Python (backend services) PostgreSQL, Redis (data layer) AWS: Lambda, ECS, S3, OpenSearch

title: Blockchain Java Backend Engineer
description: Design the future architecture of one of Europe's most innovative banking networks while empowering engineers to do their best work. Role Summary We are looking for a Blockchain Java Backend Engineer to help build the next generation of digital asset, tokenization, and distributed financial infrastructure capabilities within ING. You will design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, integration layers, event-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms that support emerging digital asset and distributed ledger initiatives. While prior blockchain experience is welcome, it is not required. We are primarily looking for strong software engineers who are passionate about building resilient, secure, and high-performing distributed systems and are interested in expanding into the blockchain and digital assets domain. Work Model At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit—it's part of how we work. Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote. We also provide additional flexibility throughout August with remote working opportunities, allowing colleagues to remain productive while staying connected with their teams. As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations and contribute to solutions used across the bank. About the Team You will join an international technology organization where ownership, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engineering excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our teams design and deliver critical technology platforms that support ING's digital transformation journey. We believe scalable architectures, strong engineering practices, automation, and continuous learning are essential for delivering reliable solutions at scale. About You Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution design, or architecture roles Strong stakeholder management experience across business and technology domains Excellent communication and presentation skills Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities Experience working in Agile organizations Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline Fluent English communication skills (C1 level or above) Technical Skills Strong experience in: Java (preferred) Kotlin Spring Boot REST APIs Microservices Architecture Experience with: Event-driven architectures Kafka RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies SQL and NoSQL databases Containerization (Docker) Kubernetes CI/CD pipelines Git-based development workflows Good understanding of: Distributed systems System integration API design Scalability patterns Roles and Responsibilities Backend Engineering & Platform Development Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs. Develop microservice-based applications running on cloud-native platforms. Create robust integration solutions between internal banking systems and emerging digital asset platforms. Build highly available, secure, and resilient services handling financial transactions and business-critical processes. Participate in architecture discussions covering scalability, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability. Distributed Systems & Digital Assets Support the design and implementation of distributed financial platforms. Contribute to digital asset, tokenization, and blockchain-related initiatives. Work on transaction workflows, settlement processes, custody integrations, and digital asset servicing capabilities. Learn and apply distributed ledger technologies where appropriate. Collaborate with blockchain engineers and architects on selected use cases. Engineering Excellence Build automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. Apply clean code principles and software craftsmanship practices. Improve observability, monitoring, logging, and operational resilience. Support production environments and participate in incident resolution activities. Contribute to reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities. Security & Compliance Implement security-by-design principles. Apply secure coding standards and software development best practices. Work closely with security, risk, and compliance teams. Ensure regulatory and internal control requirements are considered throughout solution delivery. Collaboration Work in Agile squads with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, SREs, and Security Specialists. Collaborate with global ING engineering teams. Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities, demos, and innovation initiatives. Equal Opportunity Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. What We Offer at ING Hubs Türkiye At ING Hubs Türkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. We pay attention to even the smallest details to ensure that your experience is rewarding. Be Yourself, Be an ING'er Welcome Leave: Enjoy 14 days of welcome leave, even in your first year Self-driven career opportunities Challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities Flexible hybrid working model Remote working opportunities throughout August Training budget and Udemy partnership Global mobility and international career opportunities Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family Private Pension Plan Meal Card Transportation Allowance MultiSport Membership English Language Development Support Innovation culture powered by PACE methodology Regular communication activities and celebrations About ING With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.
